matches.rationale: Pred_id 3 identifies the same mathematical inconsistency in Section 3.2.1: that multiplying by √ρ (where ρ is inversely proportional to density) boosts similarity in high-density regions, contradicting the stated goal of reducing it. This is the same defect described in gt_id 1, though pred_id 3 frames it from the opposite direction (R2 polarity irrelevance applies).

None of the findings address the contradiction about whether boundary features are noisy or informative. Pred_id 1 and 4 concern different aspects of Section 3.2.2 (the hypersphere constraint formulation and the fusion recursion formula, respectively), but neither identifies the conceptual inconsistency about boundary feature interpretation that gt_id 2 describes.
